description: Implementation of the NetworkAnonymizationKey class, including methods for creation, serialization, and feature flag checks related to network privacy and partitioning.

classes.name: NetworkAnonymizationKey
classes.description: Represents a key used for network request anonymization, supporting creation, serialization, and feature-based partitioning logic.

methods.name: NetworkAnonymizationKey
methods.description: Constructor initializing with top frame site, cross-site flag, and optional nonce.

methods.name: CreateFromFrameSite
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey from top frame and frame sites, determining cross-site status.

methods.name: CreateFromNetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey from a NetworkIsolationKey, depending on its mode.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient NetworkAnonymizationKey with an opaque site.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string for debugging, including site info, cross-site status, and nonce if present.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the key has no top site.

methods.name: IsFullyPopulated
methods.description: Checks if the key has a fully specified top site.

methods.name: IsTransient
methods.description: Determines if the key is transient (not fully populated or opaque site or has nonce).

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the key to a base::Value for storage or transmission.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Deserializes a base::Value into a NetworkAnonymizationKey.

methods.name: GetSiteDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string for a site or 'null'.

methods.name: SerializeSiteWithNonce
methods.description: Serializes a site with its nonce, if available.

methods.name: IsPartitioningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if network partitioning is enabled based on feature flags.

methods.name: PartitionByDefault
methods.description: Sets the default partitioning behavior if no features override it.

methods.name: ClearGlobalsForTesting
methods.description: Resets global flags for testing purposes.
